title: Daily digest: Noora kushti: Owaisi decodes CM Yogi-Akh | Revanth Reddy likens fight to protect vo | As Jantar Mantar loses protest site tag, | Magnitude 6 earthquake strikes off Panam | Opposition leaders move SC for full disc
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / Times of India / The Hindu
bullets_en: Noora kushti: Owaisi decodes CM Yogi-Akhilesh’s war of words.
Revanth Reddy likens fight to protect voting rights to freedom struggle.
As Jantar Mantar loses protest site tag, CJP plans get disrupted.
Opposition leaders move SC for full disclosure of SIR records, seek suspension of exercise.
bullets_ur: Noora kushti: Owaisi ne CM Yogi aur Akhilesh ki lafzi jung ki haqeeqat khol di.
Revanth Reddy ne vote ke haq ke tahaffuz ki jang ko tehreek-e-azadi se tashbeeh di.
Jantar Mantar ka ehtijaji muqam ka darja khatam hone se CJP ke plans mutasir hue.
Panama ke sahil ke qareeb 6 shiddat ka zalzala aya.
Opposition rehnumaon ne SIR records samnay lanay aur amal rokne ke liye SC se rujoo kiya.
